hero.title: Ignite Your Math Skills with
hero.description: Comprehensive online mathematics tuition for Grades 6–11 in Sinhala & English Medium. Live interactive sessions, 24/7 video recordings, and personalized WhatsApp support.

sections.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about joining MathSpark online classes and receiving study materials.
sections.processSubtitle: A systematic teaching methodology crafted to make even the hardest calculus and algebra concepts intuitive.
sections.instructorBio1: Ishan Maduranga is one of Sri Lanka's most celebrated and sought-after Mathematics educators. Known for his clarity, logical approach, and engaging teaching style, he has guided thousands of students to achieve top distinction grades in G.C.E. Ordinary Level exams.
sections.instructorBio2: His unique framework breaks down intimidating mathematical equations into simple, digestible mental models. Whether you are aiming for an 'A' grade or building fundamental confidence, his structured methodology delivers results.
sections.feat1Desc: High-definition live interactive lectures with instant video replay access available 24/7 on your personal dashboard.
sections.feat2Desc: Consistent track record of island-best and district-best rankings in G.C.E. O/L Mathematics examinations.
sections.feat3Desc: Interactive digital exam portal with automated marking, detailed paper solutions, and performance analytics.
sections.step1Desc: Deep-dive into core mathematical concepts with step-by-step proofs, visual aids, and interactive breakdown of complex syllabus topics.
sections.step2Desc: Targeted model papers, past O/L examination papers, timed MCQ tests, and monthly progress evaluations to build accuracy.
sections.step3Desc: Engaging real-time online streams with direct voice Q&A, instant doubt resolution, and full HD recording access for revision anytime.
sections.faq1Q: How do I enroll in Ishan Maduranga's Mathematics classes?
sections.faq1A: You can register a free account on MathSpark, select your grade under the Classes section, and choose your preferred batch (Sinhala or English Medium). Complete payment via online gateway or bank transfer to unlock live stream links & tutes.
sections.faq2Q: How are physical tutes and revision packs delivered?
sections.faq2A: Printed revision workbooks, past paper collections, and tute packs are dispatched via Domex Express courier to your home address in Sri Lanka. You can track your shipment anytime on our Tracking page.
sections.faq3Q: What if I miss a live online class?
sections.faq3A: Every live session is recorded in High Definition and uploaded to your student portal within 24 hours. You can re-watch any lesson as many times as you like until your final examinations.
sections.faq4Q: Can I ask questions during live online streams?
sections.faq4A: Yes! Our custom virtual classroom includes a live Q&A panel and audio mic access during designated Q&A segments so you can clarify any doubts directly with Ishan sir.
sections.faq5Q: Are classes available in both Sinhala and English medium?
sections.faq5A: Yes, we conduct separate dedicated streams for Sinhala medium and English medium students across Grades 6 to 11.

legal.privacyDesc: How MathSpark collects, uses, and protects student data.
legal.privacy1Body: MathSpark collects essential profile information—including your full name, student grade (Grades 6–11), WhatsApp contact number, and payment records—solely to deliver course materials, manage enrollments, and ship physical study packs.
legal.privacy2Body: Your personal details are used strictly for course administration, verification of student identity, live class access control, and delivery of physical tutes via delivery partners.
legal.privacy3Body: We value your trust. MathSpark does not sell, rent, trade, or share student personal data with external advertisers, marketers, or third-party brokers under any circumstances.
legal.privacy4Body: All account data is transmitted securely and stored in encrypted databases. If you have questions regarding your data privacy or wish to update your registered details, please contact our support team at +94 70 241 6592 via WhatsApp.
legal.terms1Body1: By accessing MathSpark ("the Platform"), operated by Ishan Maduranga Mathematics, you agree to abide by these Terms of Service. All course materials, live stream accesses, video recordings, MCQ test banks, and physical or digital study packs remain the exclusive intellectual property of MathSpark.
legal.terms1Body2: Account credentials are strictly non-transferable. Any unauthorized account sharing, screen recording, commercial reproduction, or redistribution of proprietary learning materials will result in immediate termination of account access without entitlement to a refund, and may incur legal action.
legal.terms2Body1: MathSpark respects student privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. We collect essential profile data—specifically your name, grade, mobile/WhatsApp contact number, and transaction records—solely to facilitate course access, process physical tute deliveries, and provide academic support.
legal.terms2Body2: Your data is stored securely and processed exclusively for MathSpark services. We do not sell, rent, or trade student personal information to third-party advertisers or external organizations under any circumstances.
legal.terms3Body1: Monthly subscription fees for live online classes and recording access packs are eligible for a refund within 7 days of purchase, provided the student has attended fewer than two live sessions and accessed no more than two recording packs.
legal.terms3Body2: Physical study materials and printed tute packs may be returned or replaced within 5 days of delivery if received damaged or incomplete. To request a refund or tute pack exchange, please contact our official support team at +94 70 241 6592 via WhatsApp.
legal.refundDesc: Clear and transparent terms for online class subscriptions and physical study materials.
legal.refund1Body: Monthly subscription fees for live online classes and recording access packs are eligible for a 100% refund within 7 days of purchase, provided the student has attended fewer than two live sessions and accessed no more than two recording packs.
legal.refund2Body: Printed study materials and physical tute packs can be returned or exchanged within 5 days of delivery if received in damaged condition, or if incorrect materials were shipped.
legal.refund3Body: To request a refund or tute exchange, please contact our support team at +94 70 241 6592 via WhatsApp with your student registration name, phone number, and payment receipt reference. Approved refunds are processed within 2–3 business days.
